acceptance: The owner has chosen: blog publishes freely, or posts about unreleased behaviour wait on next
AGENTS.md states the rule and how a blog link to a post-release core path must be written
If posts must wait, a pull request to main that adds such a post fails a named check, with a test
context: Decision gate: owner decision first; no code before it. Evidence: at cutover no blog link broke against v0.5.0 (core-links inventory check was fresh).
description: Problem: the release pin holds back documentation only. Blog posts still publish from main as soon as they merge, so a post can describe unreleased core behaviour while the docs it links to describe the pinned release. Blog links to core files are also resolved against the pinned repo-files.json and core SHA, so a post that links a path added after the pinned release fails the build until the link is pinned to a SHA. Neither rule is written down. Outcome: an owner decision, recorded in AGENTS.md, and a check if the decision needs one.
